_about: Foldiers characters (CHARS agent). All share the game mixamorig skeleton + ALL clips + the SAME hitboxes (the game attaches hit shapes to bones, see src/game/45-players hitGeometry), so no character is easier to hit. Team colour = swap the atlas (blue/red PNG, same UVs) or tint with the teammask. Units metres, +Y up, model faces -Z like the soldier (buildBot rotates it by PI).
skeleton: mixamorig (49 skinned joints, identical to assets/models/soldier.gltf.json rest pose)

chars.name: Trooper
chars.personality: Steady all-rounder in a folded gem hood: the soldier everyone wants on their side.
chars.hitbox_note: visual inside the hitboxes except the hood tip (+3 cm above the head sphere) and the sash flap

chars.name: Scout
chars.personality: Quick and cheeky, pointed hat and flared epaulettes: first through every window.
chars.look_from: trooper base (owner sheet) + ref1 pointed hat + epaulettes
chars.hitbox_note: cosmetic outside the hitboxes: hat cone tip (1.98 m, head sphere top 1.82 m) and brim (front 0.28 m vs sphere 0.15 m) - shots there MISS, like hats in other shooters

chars.name: Marksman
chars.personality: Patient watcher under a big folded hood: you never see the face, only the shot.
chars.look_from: trooper base (owner sheet) + ref3 window-soldier hood + coat tails
chars.hitbox_note: hood peak +7 cm above / +1 cm in front of the head sphere; coat tails behind the pelvis box are cosmetic

chars.name: Heavy
chars.personality: Wide, boxy and unbothered: big pauldrons, a visor slit and a very loud step.
chars.look_from: trooper base (owner sheet) + visor helmet + pauldrons + chest plate
chars.hitbox_note: pauldrons reach x 0.35 m (arm capsules cover most of them; outer 5 cm cosmetic); body visually 7% wider than the trooper but hitboxes are identical
